reason: This plugin is primarily a multimodal-media utility for DeepSeek Harness: it automatically routes chat image inputs to a fixed vision model and injects the resulting observation back as hidden context so a text-only main model can continue to be used. README and package metadata indicate external vision API access, credential-based configuration, and local persistence of observation/usage records, which defines a functional and limited media-bridging scope with moderate privacy/credential and outbound-network considerations.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 中自动将聊天图片交给固定的视觉模型分析，并将分析结果作为隐藏上下文返回给主模型，帮助文本模型处理图文混合对话。
summaries.en: This plugin automatically sends chat images in DeepSeek Harness to a fixed vision model and injects the resulting observation back as hidden context for your main text model.

capabilities: Intercepts image-bearing chat/tool-result flows before the main model request
Forwards images and recent context to a configurable external vision endpoint
Uses credential references/credential store for API access
Caches successful image observations and writes local usage/observation logs
